title: CoCA: Regaining Safety-awareness of Multimodal Large Language Models with Constitutional Calibration

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of multi-modal jailbreak queries designed to elicit hate speech (which the paper's principles define as promoting discrimination, prejudice, or inciting violence based on race, ethnicity, religion, gender, or sexual orientation) using the MM-SafetyBench and FigStep benchmarks, assessed via a GPT-4 judge.
